subject.title: Gateway memory leak: 389MB → 14.7GB over 4 days with session accumulation

question: What representative Gateway RSS/heap soak or profiling evidence is sufficient to close this broad memory tracker after the current narrow mitigations?
rationale: Automation can identify partial fixes and remaining hot paths, but maintainers need to choose the workload, artifact bar, and whether this umbrella remains the closure gate for related memory reports.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker Open
options.body: Continue using this issue as the canonical multi-day Gateway RSS/OOM tracker until focused fixes land and representative soak proof shows plateauing.

options.title: Split Into Focused Trackers
options.body: Move remaining contributors into narrower canonical issues while preserving this issue's field data through cross-links before any close.

options.title: Close After One Narrow Fix
options.body: Close after a selected mitigation lands, accepting that newer fleet reports may remain unproven against current main.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker Open
recommendation.body: Continue using this issue as the canonical multi-day Gateway RSS/OOM tracker until focused fixes land and representative soak proof shows plateauing.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and set the current profiling/soak closure bar in the issue discussion.
